games.name: Car Driving Simulator
games.desc:
Car Driving Simulator (CDS) is made by a solo developer which has a town, a city, an airport, a racing track and a massive highway. The car models are not made by me but they are modified and detailed by me to make them as perfect as possible. There are more than 100 cars to drive that have very highly detailed interiors and exteriors with very advanced driving physics.
Check the help menu in the cars list for driving modes and other controls.

Private server are free to use.
